title: Request for stop-work or rescission.
officialText:
The commissioner shall be empowered to issue a stop-work notice or order with
respect to an alteration or demolition permit and/or to rescind approval of construction documents at the request of the commissioner
of housing preservation and development pursuant to section 27-2093 of the New York city housing maintenance code.
